description.narrative: The current strategy is in place since 2004 ("Strategy for Swedish development cooperation, West Africa, Burkina Faso, Mali January 2004 - December 2006", extended to 2010). The cooperation strategies for Burkina Faso and Mali were at that time parts of the regional strategy for West Africa. During 2016-2017, Sida will prepare a cooperation strategy proposal. The strategy preparation process starts with a results analysis of Sida's development cooperation with Burkina Faso 2004-2009. It should cover the results at contribution level and identify how well Sida has succeded in implementing the objectives of the strategy and other Swedish government directives regarding development cooperation during the period. The results analysis of the current strategy period is one of the main foundations for elaborating a new cooperation strategy. This contribution aims to carry out evaluations and assessment which can serve as a valuable input into the strategy work.

Utvärderingar, studier etc. i förbindelse med förberedandet av ny samarbetsstrategi mellan Sverige och Burkina Faso. Nuvarande strategi är gällande sedan 2004 och har förlängts t o m 2016. Under 2016-17 beräknas Sida utarbeta ett nytt strategiförslag. Som underlag för denna behövs studier som analyserar tidigare insatser samt nuvarande situation i landet.
